column1: # lib/deps.tsv — the package's ONE machine-readable dependency list.
# Read by lib/deps.sh. The S0 gate (lib/preflight.sh), the installer's advisory
# report (install.sh) and docs/dependencies.md are all derived from it; a new
# dependency is one row here, and tests/test-dependencies.sh turns a row without
# a regenerated table or a runner guide into a red test.
# Format: TAB-separated, one dependency per line, '#' lines and blank lines are
# ignored. EVERY field must be non-empty (use '-' for "none"): a tab is an IFS
# whitespace character, so `read` collapses an empty field into its neighbour.
# Columns:
#   name     the command looked up on PATH (timeout: timeout or gtimeout)
#   level    required | optional — required = S0 fatal (exit 8)
#   scope    who needs it: core | security | poller | action | reviewer |
#            driver | maintenance
#   brew     install hint on macOS (and the default everywhere but apt Linux)
#   apt      install hint on a Linux with apt-get (Ubuntu, Fly.io Sprite)
#   license  the tool's own licence (the package never vendors or links any)
#   purpose  why the package needs it — printed by the installer
